snapshot.title: DAA-1 GPS Spoofing Alert — UAS-02

lines.msg: GPS signal anomaly detected: 300 ms jitter in pseudorange from PRN 13, 24.7 deg elevation
DAA-1: GPS spoofing confirmed — fake GNSS signal pulse (0.9s duration) injected at 420 ft AGL, bearing 287 deg
Position jump: 178 ft AGL → 420 ft AGL (delta +242 ft) in 6.3 sec
Class C airspace boundary crossed (HWK Class C, 200 ft AGL grid ceiling)
Geofence breach: UAS-02 entered restricted airspace (zone H-7), status: unresponsive
Link status: uplink lost at 08:58:15 (GCS-01), 3.2 sec after spoofing event
Firmware version 2.4.11a (SHA-256: d4e9a1f7b2c8e6d1a3f4b5c6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4g5h6i7j8k9l0m) active; no known override
Log export initiated by SCL (huog.example/it.scl)

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the GPS spoofing event that initiated the flyaway. The SCL must now cross-reference the firmware hash with the OEM's known-good baseline.
